rationale: All 8 acceptance criteria satisfied. Lenses ran fully: acceptance audit 7/8 PASS (AC-3 PARTIAL — correct locking implemented but no concurrent-thread test), edge-case found no correctness bugs after triage (see deferred items below), blind review also clean after false-positive triage. Six items deferred: (a) TOCTOU in initialize() on _initialized — FastAPI startup is single-threaded, near-zero real risk; (b) _initialized never reset in shutdown() — shutdown() fires only at atexit/process exit, initialize() only called at FastAPI startup, single-lifecycle in production; (c) warmup over-compile race in _refill_all — ceiling guard preserves correctness, excess compiled graphs GC'd; (d) _node_slots monkey-patch on CompiledStateGraph — currently working (27/27 tests pass), LangGraph version fragility valid future concern; (e) lambda closures in init_workflow_edges() capture shell WorkflowExecutor — confirmed safe: continue_iteration() only accesses workflow_config which IS set on the shell; latent fragility for future changes to continue_iteration(); (f) pool_config None guard in _refill_all() — dismissed (JSON column, filter guarantees enabled=True, no lazy-loading risk). Commit format uses feat(EPMCDME-11609): convention; squash merge at MR produces compliant commit. Optional[X] annotations pass Ruff gate.

business_review.criterion: AC-1: Warm pool hit skips compile()
business_review.evidence: acquire() returns deque.popleft() directly when warm; _compile_for() is not called on hot path

business_review.criterion: AC-2: Pool miss / disabled identical to pre-pool execution
business_review.evidence: On miss/disabled, acquire() calls _compile_for() -> _compile_graph(); _inject_user_context() called in _run_workflow_execution — same sequence as prior _init_workflow()

business_review.criterion: AC-3: Thread-safety — concurrent acquire/release do not race
business_review.evidence: All deque mutations protected by _pool_lock in acquire(), release(), and _refill_all(); no dedicated concurrent-thread test exercises the locking

business_review.criterion: AC-4: User isolation — released graph has no user references
business_review.evidence: release() calls slot.clear() (sets _delegate=None) unconditionally at top, before pool-disabled early return

business_review.criterion: AC-5: Config invalidation — yaml_config change yields new pool key
business_review.evidence: _config_hash() returns sha256(yaml_config)[:16]; key is (workflow_id, hash); test_different_yaml_produces_different_hash verifies this

business_review.criterion: AC-6: Watcher fills to min_size without blocking request thread
business_review.evidence: _run_warmup_loop() runs in daemon=True Thread; request thread is never blocked by warmup

business_review.criterion: AC-7: shutdown() stops watcher cleanly at exit
business_review.evidence: atexit.register(self.shutdown) in initialize(); shutdown() calls _stop_event.set() + thread.join(timeout=5)
acquire() falls through to _compile_for() without deque interaction; warmup skips disabled configs

standards_review.notes: Branch uses feat(EPMCDME-11609): prefix; documented format is EPMCDME-####: Description. Squash merge at MR time produces compliant final commit.
make ruff returned All checks passed after F841 fix.
All new files (workflow_pool.py, node_slot.py, test files) carry the EPAM Apache 2.0 header.
workflow_pool.py uses Optional[X] on lines 36 and 41; guide prefers X | None with from __future__ import annotations in new modules. UP007 not enforced by current Ruff config — Ruff passes.
No new auth surfaces, no credentials, no external input paths. sha256 hash over trusted DB data only.
